notes.title: Update 0.0.4
notes.content:
Long time, no update! 

This update contains the following:

[b]Solo mode[/b]
A new singleplayer mode where you take out targets.
Of course we added a leaderboard, you competitive nerds! 

[b]New cosmetics[/b]
2 new cosmetics items
Rastaman hat and a Bong weapon.
Make Elon play the game! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32934840/11ec881bcf7efa34db5787749386bd9715845c9a.png[/img]

[b]A Sweet Studio[/b]
More information on future updates and what's going on in the studio right now will come really really soon! 
Stay tuned friends!

notes.title: Update 0.0.3
notes.content:
Friends!
We have fixed bugs and updated Climb again.
This time around we worked on:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards.
Weekly leaderboard, based on wins.
[*]French cosmetic kit.
Congratulations on the world cup win!
[*]Added Australian servers.
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Spawn system.
Don't spawn over lava, and spawn further from other players.
[*]Moving platforms sync over network.
[*]Graphical bugs in leaderboards.
[*]Graphical bugs in killfeed.
[/list]

Thanks for your support and feedback. Keep it coming.

Join our Discord for direct communication with the development team and community managers.

notes.title: Update 0.0.2
notes.content:
Hi all.
First of all, we want to thank you for your support and patience.
We have fixed a whole lot of things, and those are:

[list]
[*] Steam friends invites and lobby (a lot of work!)
[*] 2 new levels
[*] A new set of cosmetics - Sailor
[*] IAP for cosmetics
[*] Rage quit lobby bug
[*] 16:10 graphic bugs
[*] Sorting of hearts
[*] Collison fixes on moving platforms
[*] Link to official Climb discord
[*] Removed unused servers
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32934840/ef19b9f359b3c521a0bd4ba11926345f074973ed.png[/img]

Once again, thanks for your support and help! 
We now have a much stable game that can be built upon!

/Team Sweet.
